blocks.text: MANILA — Scam attempts continued to rise in the Philippines, with 84 percent of Filipino adults reporting exposure to at least one attempt in the past year, up from 77 percent in 2025, according to the State of Scams Philippines 2026 Report released Thursday. Scam losses were estimated at PHP121.8 billion annually based on survey responses, not on verified or reported figures, the report showed. The figure was extrapolated from the 15 percent of respondents who reported losing money or personal data, with victims reporting an average loss of PHP10,427 each. “Behind every scam statistic is a person: someone who trusted […]...
